kedaCronSchedules.description:
Cron windows applied when scaling_mode is KEDA_CRON; must be non-empty
for that mode and is ignored otherwise.

kedaHttpTargetPendingRequests.description: HTTP add-on concurrency target applied when scaling_mode is KEDA_HTTP.

parameters.name: applicationId
parameters.description:
Required: the application whose logs are requested. Ownership is validated
against the caller's organization before any upstream query is issued.

parameters.name: environmentId
parameters.description: Optional additional scoping. When set they must belong to application_id.

parameters.name: minSeverity
parameters.description: Optional coarse severity floor. Records below it are excluded.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
Optional free-text substring filter. Validated as a safe literal and ANDed
onto the mandatory tenant filter; it cannot remove or widen tenant scope.

parameters.name: targetType
parameters.description: Optional filters. When set, only events whose target matches are returned.

EnvironmentServiceCreateProductionEnviro.description:
CreateProductionEnvironmentRequest provisions a production environment for
an application. hostname is optional: when empty the platform auto-generates
it from the app's hostname_label and the configured preview_hostname_suffix
(§7.5). When provided it is used as-is, which is how operators attach their
own domain after initial setup.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

 - NULL_VALUE: Null value.

v1Alias.description:
Alias is one row of the aliases table: a bookkeeping record of which release
currently serves at a hostname for an environment (§3.7). There is at most
one alias per environment (UNIQUE(environment_id)).

kedaCronSchedules.description:
Cron windows applied when scaling_mode is KEDA_CRON; must be non-empty
for that mode and is ignored otherwise.

kedaHttpTargetPendingRequests.description: HTTP add-on concurrency target applied when scaling_mode is KEDA_HTTP.

actorUserId.description:
actor_user_id is the user who performed the action; empty for
system-originated events.

before.description:
before/after are the JSON object states of the target resource. They are
exposed as google.protobuf.Struct because the stored jsonb is always a JSON
object (or null), mapping cleanly to Struct; this preserves structure for
clients rather than an opaque string.

v1AuditEvent.description:
AuditEvent is one row of the audit_events table: an immutable record of a
control-plane mutation (§9). before/after carry the prior and resulting
resource state as JSON objects. These are org-scoped; a caller can only read
their own org's audit trail. The stored `after` for secret-bearing resources
(e.g. registries) contains the secret REFERENCE, never a plaintext secret.

v1CertificateStatus.description:
CertificateStatus is the live status of a cert-manager Certificate serving an
environment's hostname, read directly from the cluster (read-only, §6). It is
not stored in Postgres; it is projected from the Certificate CRD's spec and
status. ready reflects the Ready condition; reason carries the condition's
message; not_after is the certificate expiry when known.

verificationToken.description:
verification_token is only populated for dns_txt domains; it is the value
the customer must publish in the challenge TXT record. It is null/empty for
cname domains.

instructions.description:
instructions describes the exact DNS record the customer must create to
complete verification and, for dns_txt, the follow-up A record.

recordName.description:
record_name is the fully-qualified name the customer creates the record on
(e.g. "app.customer.com" for CNAME, "_cyclopus-challenge.customer.com" for
TXT).

recordValue.description:
record_value is the expected value: the ingress target for CNAME, or the
challenge token for TXT.

apexARecordTarget.description:
apex_a_record_target is set for dns_txt domains only: after verification the
customer points an A record at this ingress IP/target. Cyclopus does not
verify this record in this phase; it is operational guidance.

v1DomainDnsInstructions.description:
DomainDnsInstructions is the operator-facing guidance the UI/CLI renders so
the customer can create the records Cyclopus checks (§7.5).

v1DomainVerificationMethod.description:
DomainVerificationMethod selects how a custom domain proves control (§7.5).
CNAME is used for subdomains (the CNAME both proves control and routes
traffic); DNS_TXT is used for apex/root domains via a challenge TXT record.

metrics.description:
Operator-level only. Any authenticated org member may read these; they are
deliberately install-scoped and expose no tenant data.

provider.description: provider is "github" (the only supported value in v1).

webhookSecretRef.description:
webhook_secret_ref is a k8s-secret://<namespace>/<name>#<key> reference to
the webhook signing secret, NOT a plaintext secret.

v1GitConnection.description:
GitConnection is one row of the git_connections table: a GitHub App
installation bound to a single repository. webhook_secret_ref is a
k8s-secret://<namespace>/<name>#<key> REFERENCE to the webhook signing
secret; the raw secret is never accepted or stored in Postgres.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name for the cron window (for example "Europe/Berlin").

start.description: 5-field cron expression marking the start of the scale-out window.

end.description: 5-field cron expression marking the end of the scale-out window.

desiredReplicas.description: Replicas to hold during the window.

v1LogEntry.description:
LogEntry is a single tenant-scoped log record returned from OpenObserve. The
tenant fields that determine ownership are stamped by the OpenTelemetry
Collector at ingest (spec 8.1), never claimed by the app.

v1LogSeverity.description:
LogSeverity is the coarse severity band a log query may filter on. Cyclopus
maps it to an OpenObserve severity predicate that is ANDed onto the mandatory
tenant filter; it can never widen scope.

v1OperatorMetric.description:
OperatorMetric is one install-level host/system metric proxied from Beszel.
These are NOT tenant-scoped: they describe the operator's own hosts and carry
no per-application attribution (spec 8, design note: Beszel is operator/
install-level bounded metrics, not a transparent per-tenant proxy).

provider.description:
provider identifies the registry flavour: one of "ghcr", "gcr", "ecr",
"other".

credentialSecretRef.description:
credential_secret_ref is a k8s-secret://<namespace>/<name>#<key> reference
to the pull credential, NOT a plaintext credential.

v1Registry.description:
Registry is one row of the registries table: an OCI image registry an app
pulls container images from. credential_secret_ref is a
k8s-secret://<namespace>/<name>#<key> REFERENCE to the pull credential; the
raw credential is never accepted or stored in Postgres — only the reference.
